name: B10-0408/2025 – § 13 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Second World Summit for Social Development
part_text: 13. Stresses that any transition policies must first enhance industrial competitiveness, create more jobs, and safeguard the purchasing power of European citizens; warns that the so-called green transition, as framed under the European Green Deal, has already generated disproportionate costs, factory closures and job losses; insists that the Member States retain full sovereignty to define their own energy and industrial mix, without being bound by ideological climate dogmas;
